snippet.title: WILL: Follow The Light Release Date Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
A new trailer for TomorrowHead Studio's WILL: Follow The Light gave viewers a release date for this fast-approaching arctic sailing odyssey. It's coming to PC, PlayStation and Xbox on April 28, 2026.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3144860/WILL_Follow_The_Light/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
